problems: royal-domain-of-france and burgundian-state are layers: they overlap the Cliopatria Kingdom of France (990-1791) and Duchy of Burgundy (1003-1481), Flanders, Brabant, Holland rows. The compile must draw them over those rows.

duchy-of-berry, duchy-of-orleans, county-of-ponthieu and county-of-la-marche are carved out of the royal domain; holder changes in Ponthieu and La Marche are rename events and the gains and losses sit in royal-domain-of-france.
kingdom-of-france lacks a vassal_start for duchy-of-bar (Treaty of Bruges, 1301) and lacks the loss events matching the Catholic League 1588-1598.
pale-of-calais is overdrawn at grid resolution (about 500-1,500 km2 against an infobox 52 km2); the compile should draw it as a one- or two-cell exclave.
Confidence-1 events: burgundian-state 1463 loss and 1477 Alsace loss; catholic-league-france 1594 Normandy loss and 1596 Aix loss (pages silent).

Page conflicts: Ponthieu 1336 (Crown lands) vs the Ponthieu page sequence 1279-1369; Hainaut/Luxembourg/Namur/Flanders dates differ between the Burgundian State and Philip pages; 1308 Angouleme purchase vs La Marche seizure. Each event uses the cited page's year.

The Crown lands page has no infobox; the 1498 entry brings Blois into the domain for the first time (not a return), so the Blois claim in the first Orleans draft was removed and royal-domain-of-france carries the Blois gain with counterpart county-of-blois (Cliopatria shape 1401).
county-of-provence ends December 1481 (the Crown lands page date) not 1486/1487 (County page) so that the royal domain and Provence do not both hold the land.

Counterparts with no Cliopatria row and no dossier: county-of-sens, viscounty-of-bourges, county-of-chartres, county-of-forcalquier (validator warns); County of Namur, Duchy of Guelders (free text in burgundian-state).

Gazetteer names Montargis, Abbeville and Boulogne-sur-Mer are unknown; the validator reports 49 (royal-domain-of-france), 10 (burgundian-state) and 6 (county-of-ponthieu) resolve warnings, all of those names.
